# Lab 4.15: Configure SSO with a Third-party IdP

## What We Are Going to Do
Make Cloud Identity users sign in through an external SAML identity provider, using a free Okta developer account.

## Steps

1. **Create a free Okta account.** Sign up for an Okta Integrator Free account. Create a user in Okta whose username matches a Cloud Identity user, for example `alice@yourdomain`.

2. **Get Google's SAML details.** In the Admin console go to **Security → Authentication → SSO with third-party IdP** and click **Add SAML profile**. Name it `Okta`. Copy the **Entity ID** and **ACS URL** that Google shows.

3. **Create the SAML app in Okta.** In Okta, go to **Applications → Create App Integration → SAML 2.0**. Paste the ACS URL as **Single sign-on URL** and the Entity ID as **Audience URI**. Set **Name ID format** to **EmailAddress** and **Application username** to **Email**. Assign the app to Alice.

4. **Copy Okta's details back.** From the Okta app's **Sign On** tab, copy the **Sign-on URL**, **Issuer** and download the **certificate**. Paste them into the Google SAML profile and upload the certificate. Save.

5. **Assign the profile.** On the same Admin console page, under **Manage SSO profile assignments**, assign the **Okta** profile to the **Engineering** OU only. Keep Super Admins on Google sign-in.

6. **Test it.** In a private window, go to `https://console.cloud.google.com` and enter `alice@yourdomain`. You are sent to Okta, then back to Google signed in.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Sign-in for Engineering | Redirected to Okta |
| Super Admins | Still sign in with Google, by design |
| User accounts | Must still exist in Cloud Identity |
| Scope | SSO profile assigned per OU or group |
